notes.title: Halloween Event and update 1.3.1 released
notes.notes:
[h1]Halloween[/h1]
[list]
[*]Halloween decorations have brought ghosts to the overworld - complete the coin challenge to unlock a special Halloween hat!
[/list]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1189187723
[h1]Game[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added support for overworld events where players can unlock unique outfit options.
[*]Updated the camera to avoid collisions with the ground and to adjust the zoom level if a collision with an object near the camera could be avoided.
[*]Added support for items with two button inputs. Default item auxiliary hotkey is shift for keyboard and left trigger for gamepads.
[*]Added interface showing the keyboard controls for an item when standing on the item pad.
[*]Changed glider activation to auxiliary item hotkey.
[*]Added new Speed Boost item - try it out in the main park where you can find it near Star Pier.
[*]Added gyroball collision sound effects.
[*]Added glider wind sound effects.
[*]Added text wrapping for notifications with long zone names.
[/list]
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Major performance improvement when rendering prefab button previews.
[*]Added ability to rotate prefab buttons previews by right clicking and dragging. Prefab previews no longer spin continuously.
[*]Changed prefab buttons previews to use the default lighting.
[*]Added support to use zone generation when editing prefabs by using the destroy/generate action.
[*]Added ability to enter practice mode while editing prefabs.
[*]Added ability to modify spline points in the scene directly.
[*]Added sound object outlines when the sound panel is open.
[*]Added particle object outlines when the particle panel is open.
[*]Fixed crash in practice mode if the hotkey to show player names was pressed.
[/list]
[h1]Engine[/h1]
[list]
[*]Particles now render after transparent meshes providing better transparency sorting in most situations.
[/list]


The overworld will return to normal after Halloween - but a permanent Halloween level will be added to the main park later in October.

notes.title: Launch Update
notes.notes:
The game should be available now, but the store page is still showing as "Coming Soon". There is a pending Steamworks support ticket to help resolve this issue. I will update this as soon as there is more information. Sorry for the delay.


Edit: Steam support resolved the issue with the store page. Park Bound is now live!
